steps.en: Describe the objects, the containers, and the starting assignment
steps.zh: 描述对象、容器，以及初始分配

steps.en: Declare the dimensions, then compose goals and constraints out of named specs
steps.zh: 声明维度，再用现成的 spec 组合出目标与约束

steps.en: Compiles those specs into an expression graph — you write no LP formulas
steps.zh: 把 spec 编译成表达式图——LP 公式一行都不用写

steps.en: Pick the algorithm and the move types it may use
steps.zh: 选求解算法，以及它可用的 move types

steps.en: Applies improving moves until nothing improves or the time limit hits, then returns the best assignment
steps.zh: 反复应用改进移动，直到再无改进或到达时间上限，返回最佳分配

value.en: You get a constraint-satisfying, goal-optimized assignment map — no linear program to write by hand
value.zh: 你拿到一个满足约束、且按目标优化过的分配表——不用手写线性规划

sources: README → Quick Example (Python): `ProblemSolver(service_name=…, service_scope=…)`; chained `set_object_name("task")`, `set_container_name("host")`, `set_assignment({…})`; `add_object_dimension` / `add_container_dimension`; `add_constraint(ConstraintSpec(capacitySpec=CapacitySpec(…)))`; `add_solver(SolverSpec(localSearchSolverSpec=LocalSearchSolverSpec(moveTypeList=[MoveTypeSpec(singleMoveTypeSpec=SingleMoveTypeSpec()), MoveTypeSpec(swapMoveTypeSpec=SwapMoveTypeSpec())])))`; `solution = solver.solve()`; `solution["assignment"]`

website/docs/getting-started/first-model.md — tutorial builds objects/containers/initial assignment, dimensions, then `BalanceSpec`, `ToFreeSpec` and a group-count constraint, picks local search, and prints the resulting placement
website/docs/intro.md → "An expressive DSL" / "A choice of solvers" (25+ built-in specs; the model is independent of the solver: local search scales, the MIP path gives proven optimality)

website/docs/solvers/local-search/local-search.md — default solver when unspecified; each iteration evaluates small changes, applies the best improving one, repeats until a local optimum or `solveTime`; `moveTypeList` is required and an empty list is rejected
website/docs/solvers/overview.md — the optimal solver translates the problem into a linear-programming model and hands it to HiGHS, Gurobi or FICO Xpress (time-limited run possible)
